entries.text: 1. The mother of Jesus Mt 1:16; Lu 1:26-38; 2:5-19
Visits her cousin, Elisabeth Lu 1:39-56
Attends the feast at Jerusalem with her husband and her son, starts back on the return, misses Jesus, seeks and finds him in the temple area Lu 2:48-51
Is present with Jesus at a marriage feast in Cana of Galilee Joh 2:1-10
Seeks Jesus when he is teaching in a house Mt 12:46,47; Mr 3:31; Lu 8:19
Present at the cross Joh 19:25-27
Is committed to the care of John Joh 19:27
Lives with the disciples in Jerusalem Ac 1:14
Prophecies concerning Isa 7:14; Lu 2:35
Possessed of devils, delivered by Jesus Mr 16:9; Lu 8:2,3
Present at the crucifixion Mt 27:56; Mr 15:40; Joh 20:1,11-13
Recognizes Jesus after the resurrection Mt 28:8-10; Mr 16:9; Joh 20:14-18
3. Sister of Mary the mother of Jesus, and wife of Cleophas Joh 19:25
Mother of James and Joses Mt 27:56; Mr 15:40; Joh 19:25
At the gravesite of Jesus Mt 27:61; Mr 15:47
Assists in preparing the corpse of Jesus for burial Mt 28:1; Mr 16:1
A witness of the resurrection Lu 24:10
Sits at Jesus’ feet for instruction Lu 10:38-42
Beloved of Jesus Joh 11:1,5
Anoints Jesus Mt 26:7-13; Mr 14:3-9; Joh 11:2; 12:3
5. Mother of Mark and sister of Barnabas Ac 12:12; Col 4:10
6. A Christian woman in Rome Ro 16:6
